examples.sql: SELECT {fn DAYOFWEEK('2018-02-22')}||' '||DATENAME('dw','2018-02-22') AS ODBCDoW, {fn DAYOFWEEK(64701)}||' '||DATENAME('dw','64701') AS HorologDoW

SELECT {fn DAYOFWEEK({fn NOW()})} AS DoW_Now, {fn DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT_DATE)} AS DoW_CurrDate, {fn DAYOFWEEK(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)} AS DoW_CurrTstamp, {fn DAYOFWEEK($ZTIMESTAMP)} AS DoW_ZTstamp, {fn DAYOFWEEK($HOROLOG)} AS DoW_Horolog
